info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Banking Enterprise Services Security Advisory By Security Advisory Id-v5-spec
info.description: This API enables financial institutions to update existing security advisories within the Banking Enterprise Services. Users can modify the details of a specific security advisory identified by its unique ID. Typical consumers include risk management teams and security analysts who need to ensure that the latest security protocols are accurately reflected in the system. This operation supports compliance and enhances the organization's ability to respond to evolving security threats effectively.
